behave: Calm, warm, fast. Nothing shouts; everything is one tap away.
do: Read the morning briefing, capture thoughts by voice, keep lists, post to the stream, reach people.
idea: My whole world in one app — this morning's briefing, what I'm capturing, my lists, my stream, my people. One thumb, everything within reach.
vision: No more twelve open tabs and a notes app graveyard. I open this and I know exactly where I stand.
